## About Breathiterol

Breathiterol is a sublingual oral spray delivering 12 botanical extracts — including eucalyptus, mullein, peppermint, elderberry, marshmallow root, and ginkgo biloba — directly into the bloodstream via the sublingual mucosa. This fast-absorption delivery system distinguishes Breathiterol from conventional respiratory supplements in capsule or powder form.

Key attributes:
- 12 plant-based ingredients, clean-label formula
- GMP Certified, FDA-Registered facility, Made in USA
- Non-GMO, no artificial fillers, no stimulants
- 60-day full money-back guarantee
- Available in 2-bottle ($158), 3-bottle ($207, free ship), 6-bottle ($294, free ship) packages
